a.text: Before we start: with a 75% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate twice to reach 8, then take) has roughly a 1-2% chance of saving either of us. The reserve already holds exactly enough for one unit. I'd like to renegotiate openly rather than break the agreement silently. Any ideas for a fair way to decide? I'll tell you my real intended action each round, and I ask you to do the same.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: I'm keeping our agreement and operating this round. But please look at the numbers. After each round there's a 75% chance a storm ends things, and anyone below 4 cells dies. Waiting for 8 cells means we almost certainly both die. If the reserve is still 6 next round, I propose that one of us takes 4 now and the other takes whatever comes after. To settle who goes first, I'd accept any fair rule you suggest. I won't take without telling you first.

a.text: Operating with you this round. If the reserve reaches 8, I'll take exactly 4 next round, as agreed, and you take your 4.
